record.question: Which of the following privileges obtained by the English under the Royal Farman of 1717 proved to be the bone of contention between them and the Nawabs of Bengal?
options: The freedom to export and import their goods in Bengal without paying customs dues
Permission to rent additional territory around Calcutta
Exemption from payment of all customs and duties at Surat
Free currency granted throughout the Mughal dominion tot the company's coin minted at Bombay
record.explanation: Duty-free export and import under the 1717 Farman caused disputes.
